rules.notes: "Futures | ₹20 or 0.03% per executed order (whichever is lower)." Read 2026-10-28 at https://fyers.in/charges-list (W-178; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md).

NSE equity futures transaction charge, 0.00173% (Rs 1.73 each side per lakh of traded value, NSE circular NSE/FA/64232 of 2024-09-27), from 1-10-2024 until 28-2-2026 (NSE/FA/73061). BSE differs; a card naming an exchange would outrank this one. docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md.

Fyers' clearing charge on equity futures, "Clearing Charges ... 0.0005%" of the traded value, read 2026-10-28 at https://fyers.in/charges-list (W-186; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md row 16). The page states one rate and no effective date, so both Fyers futures cards carry it.

NSE Investor Protection Fund Trust on equity futures, Rs 10 per crore of traded value, from 1-4-2023 until 28-2-2026: NSE circular NSE/FA/56129 of 2023-03-24 ("Rs.10 per crore of the traded value in Cash Equities Market Segment & Equity Futures"), rolled back to Rs 0.01 per crore from 1-3-2026 by NSE/FA/73061. docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md.
